headlines.title: Oman supports peaceful resolution of disputes
Oman expands zero-rated VAT list to 807 food items
Oman to get 700 new hotel rooms by year-end: Report
Oman drafts national law for space economy

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Oman supports peaceful resolution of disputes. [1]
Oman expands zero-rated VAT list to 807 food items. [2]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR OMAN
Oman's support for peaceful resolution of disputes is relevant given the Strait of Hormuz is a shipping chokepoint World Monitor tracks for Oman. [1][E4]

KEY RISKS
Oman is linked to 32 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations, as of Sep 28, 2026. [E2]
The most severe government travel advisory World Monitor tracks for Oman is Reconsider Travel, as of Sep 28, 2026. [E1]

OUTLOOK
A Polymarket market related to Oman, "Iran-Oman Hormuz Agreement by October 31?", priced Yes at 23% on Sep 28, 2026; it closes Oct 31, 2026. [E5]

WATCH ITEMS
Oman drafts national law for space economy. [4]
The outcome of the Polymarket market "Iran-Oman Hormuz Agreement by October 31?" is unresolved. [E5]
